steps.summary: Reviewed skill skills/doughhouse.json (ids snake_case incl. options ml_500/l_1_25, groups size/dough/toppings/volume, no defaults; forbiddenLabels 주문하기, 💳 신용/체크카드, 결제, 카드 matched as substrings via isForbiddenLabel; recipes startOrder/addToCart as learned + removeLine clickNth 삭제 {lineIndex}; cartLinePattern groups name/opts/qty/price). Kiosk page copied byte-identical to public/learned-kiosks/doughhouse/index.html; placeholder public/learned-kiosks/item.svg. src/lib/adapters/learned.ts: skillSchema (strict, recursive RecipeStep), learnedToKiosk -> KioskData kind 'learned' with learned{page, recipes, dineLabels, uiLabels, forbiddenLabels, patterns, labels{items,categories,options} by id}. types/menu.ts: RecipeStep, LearnedKiosk, KioskData.kind/learned. getKiosk('doughhouse') works (KioskId union); kioskSchema (direct) unchanged. Tests in learned.test.ts (20). ARCHITECTURE skill format updated. Note: until step 1, doughhouse sessions have no learned-kiosk guards (cardAction etc.).

steps.name: bridge-server
steps.summary: Session gains pendingBridgeCommand ({commandId, type setDineOption|addToCart|removeFromCart, args, lineIndex (remove only), source, at}; types BridgeChange/PendingBridgeCommand in src/types/session.ts) and bridgeStatus {lastOk, at}; newSession null, both in toPublicSession (the bridge reads pending via SSE). machine.ts: applyCommand routes kiosk.kind 'learned' to learnedTransition: setDineOption/addToCart/removeFromCart validated as direct then stored pending, result {pending:true}; undo only after an add that made a new line -> pending removeFromCart; updateCart CONFLICT 'On this kiosk, please remove the item and add it again.'; confirmCheckout/editOrder/cardAction/clearCart CONFLICT 'Please finish and pay on the kiosk screen.'; while pending, the three + undo + requestCheckout get CONFLICT 'The kiosk is still working on your last request.' (callStaff/offerChoices/cancelCheckout still work); pending older than BRIDGE_TIMEOUT_MS 20 s -> cleared, staffCalled learned_mismatch, bridgeStatus false (also on its late report). New kiosk-only command bridgeReport {commandId, ok, kioskTotal int>=0|null, kioskLines <=20x<=120} (schemas, ACTOR_COMMANDS.kiosk); server rebuilds the change with cart.ts and applies only if ok && kioskTotal === expected total (lastChange.source = original source), else mismatch; kioskLines never stored or compared server-side (bridge compares lines in step 2); bridgeReport keeps pendingChoice; CONFLICT on direct kiosks. withCart now takes source; withDineOption extracted. service: CommandResponse.pending (also on duplicates). Agent: toolResult adds pending + 'The kiosk is doing it now; say you are adding it and wait.'; toolDeclarations omits updateCart/confirmCheckout for learned (7); buildInstructions adds a '## This kiosk' section for learned. Tests in machine/service/tools/mapping/instructions tests. ARCHITECTURE, UX synced; I-094 logged.

steps.name: bridge-client
steps.summary: src/lib/bridge/: labels.ts (clickables/markClickables/findByLabel, the driver's label rules via the frame's own getComputedStyle, no marker attributes written to the page), recipe.ts (pure planSteps: forEach/repeat/{placeholders}, refuses missing vars, counts outside 0..20 and any label/name/text containing a forbiddenLabel; runPlan: exactly-one target by label, clickNth, role+name on input radio/checkbox by <label> text, or text; 3 s per step, clickIfVisible looks once; isForbiddenTarget checks label and full element text before every click; settle = 2 frames + 50 ms quiet, max 300 ms), verify.ts (readKioskTotal, readKioskLines cut to the matched part, parseKioskLine, sameLines compares sums per name+sorted options since the server merges repeated lines), bridge.ts (changeVars/expectedLines from the catalog by id before any click; createBridge({doc,kiosk,sessionId,kioskToken,send}).handle(pending, session): home check -> startOrder with session dine or eat-in; setDineOption after the kiosk order started fails unless unchanged (I-095); verifies lines, closes dialogs on failure, sends bridgeReport, never retries, dedupes by commandId, one at a time; returns {commandId, ok, ms}). Host: src/app/learned/[kioskId]/page.tsx + src/components/learned/LearnedKioskHost.tsx (LearnedKioskApp uses useKioskSession; LearnedKioskHost(kiosk, session, kioskToken, claimUrl) for /demo; iframe 1080x1600 scaled and letterboxed; bridge kept in a ref; KIBO widget top-right with QR img[data-claim-url], phone connected, aria-live status, data-bridge-ok/data-staff-called/data-replay-command/-ok/-ms). Tests: recipe/verify/bridge unit tests (24); e2e/learned.spec.ts (dine, pepperoni 24,200 + cola 1.25L 3,300 = 27,500, remove cola, hand-edited kiosk cart -> learned_mismatch) writes evidence/bridge-replay.json (replay 68-528 ms); e2e/qa/learned.qa.spec.ts + LEARNED profile (0 H, 0 T). Docs: TESTING ledger row, ARCHITECTURE dirs, UI_QA, ISSUE I-068 3rd occurrence -> R-005 (own X-Forwarded-For per spec), I-095, I-096.

steps.name: learned-assistant
steps.summary: Phone on a learned kiosk: phoneScreen(session, local, learned) -> 'confirmLearned' (P4 without [Yes, pay now]: lines, total, "Tap 주문하기 (Order) on the kiosk and pay there." from the skill's new required checkout{label,name} field (must be a forbidden label; skills/doughhouse.json, skillSchema refine, LearnedKiosk.checkout), [Pick more]); bridgeNotice(session, now, clockOffset) in src/lib/phone/screen.ts: pending -> 'The kiosk is entering it…' (plain text on the cart card/dine/confirm), >=15 s (BRIDGE_SLOW_MS) -> 'Please check the kiosk screen.' + [Call staff], bridgeStatus.lastOk false or a learned_mismatch staff call newer than the last good replay -> mismatch line (generic staff banner hidden then). [Undo] on learned only when learnedUndoLine (new src/lib/commands/undo.ts, shared with machine.ts) allows it, disabled while pending. /assistant now lists doughhouse (I-097) with pizza examples and placeholder (I-098). /demo?k=doughhouse: page reads k under Suspense, DemoApp keyed by kiosk; D1 kiosk picker (links with aria-current, check icon); D2 left = LearnedKioskHost keyed by session (Try again reloads the page), width (100dvh-72px)*27/40, caption 'Kiosk (unchanged third-party screen, learned once by KIBO Learn)', learnedExamples; D3 learned end card ([Try again], [Try MALO BURGER] -> /demo) on the learned review. Landing / links 'Try the learned pizza kiosk'. I-095 decided: learned instructions ask dine option before the first addToCart. Tests: unit (screen, phone copy, learned skill, undo, instructions) 566 pass; e2e/demo-learned.spec.ts (+@live); QA learned-phone.qa.spec.ts (192.0.2.23) and D1/D2/D3 learned in demo.qa.spec.ts; lint, build, test:e2e 8 pass, qa:ui 16 pass 0 H. test:e2e:live: all 4 failed with UPSTREAM (no Gemini reachable from this shell, incl. previously passing MALO tests); evidence files rewritten by the runs were restored (I-099). Docs: ARCHITECTURE skill checkout, UX C1/C5/P4/D1/D3, UI_QA; ISSUE I-073 seen, I-095 fixed, I-097..I-100.
